name: Recycled PU Yoga Mat - Darkstone
description: Experience comfort and balance with our Arch Shaped Recycled PU Yoga Mat—crafted from eco-conscious recycled PU and natural tree rubber for non-slip grip, joint support, and mindful movement. Its curved design promotes alignment and flow in every practice.

productPageSections.heading: Soul of the product
items: Grippy PU surface for non-slip performance even with sweat
Wider than traditional mats for extra space
Arch shaped Mat
Tree rubber bottom provides secure floor grip
5mm high rubber density for joint cushioning
Free from harmful silicone, phthalates, PVC, and chemicals
Ideal for both regular and hot yoga sessions
Excellent durability for long-lasting use

productPageSections.heading: Material
items: Recycled PU Leather, 100% natural tree rubber, water based inks

productPageSections.heading: Care guide
items: We recommend you clean using a yoga mat cleaner. Spray clean the PU top and then wipe the mat. Let it Air Dry (Do not put in washer or dryer)

productPageSections.heading: Mindful craftsmanship
items: PU is an artificial material made with split leather (the fibrous part of the hide left over from making leather) that does not involve animals and it is ethically sourced. We use recycled PU.

The other side of the mat is made with sustainably harvested tree rubber from rubber trees, a renewable resource. These mats don't contain any PVC, formaldehyde, or harmful chemicals making your mat both kind to you and kind to the earth.

productPageSections.heading: Mindful craftsmanship
items: Hemp is a “bast fibre” which means it’s derived from the stems of plants such as flax, jute and stinging nettle. Hemp is gentle on the earth as it requires very little water. The other side of the mat is made with sustainably harvested tree rubber from rubber trees, a renewable resource. These mats don't contain any PVC, EVA or synthetic rubber making your mat both kind to you and kind to the earth.
The best thing: They come from the earth, they go back into the earth! The mat is 100% biodegradable, so by buying it you aren't increasing your carbon footprint.

productPageSections.heading: Mindful craftsmanship
items: Cork is the outer bark of the Oak Tree. The Oak tree is never cut down to harvest cork, rather the bark is stripped by hand! No part of the bark is wasted during cork production. Oak trees regenerate their bark by absorbing five times more Carbon Dioxide than an oak tree that hasn't been harvested.

The other side of the mat is made with sustainably harvested tree rubber from rubber trees, a renewable resource. These mats don't contain any PVC, EVA or synthetic rubber making your mat both kind to you and kind to the earth.
All designs are made using water-based inks to avoid chemicals
